sources.scope: German telephone-directory surname ranking dated 2005-01-06; 3,421 entries over 1,000 directory listings, published as a Germany-specific list.
sources.limitations: Historic 2005 telephone listings, not a current resident or birth census; businesses and shared phone numbers can bias the source; country-specific lexical attestation only. Values from source, not generated combinations. Obvious institutional false positives excluded. Wiktionary page CC BY-SA 4.0: attribution/share-alike rights require review before production use.
